blockingFindings: persistCodexAppReviewResult does not revalidate the current HEAD/base or rehash every context-manifest entry at the persistence boundary, so a Codex-app review prepared on one committed context could persist after governed files or the reviewed head changed. This violates fail-closed SHA/context binding and the packet's claimed governed-file rehashing.
missingNegativeTests: Reject Codex-app persistence after HEAD or origin/main changes between preparation and persistence.
Reject persistence when any non-required context-manifest file changes or its hash is forged.
Reject context-manifest paths escaping the repository root.

architectureAssessment.deepModules: Review parsing, cancellation, evidence sequencing, and persistence are separated into bounded helpers, but app persistence lacks final context binding.
architectureAssessment.hexagonalArchitecture: CLI and Codex-app paths share launcher-bound review results and evidence gates; provider fallback and production authority remain excluded.
architectureAssessment.eventedBoundaries: Progress and terminal cancellation states are explicit and redacted, with child/tree confirmation; stale app events still require a final persistence gate.

exactNextAction: Add a persistence-boundary check that re-reads current HEAD and origin/main, verifies every context-manifest path remains contained and hash-identical, recomputes the manifest hash, and rejects drift before writing any trace or review result; add the listed negative tests and rerun all packet-required checks.
